The method `getFileReservedHours()` accesses `topicMetadata` without checking for null. If `topicMetadata` is not initialized, a `NullPointerException` will be thrown. In the case of `#SA3G2`, this call occurs within a scheduled task; an uncaught exception here would cause the entire cleanup scheduler to stop executing, preventing further file expiration and potentially leading to disk space issues.
